downloadButton <- function(...) {
  tag <- shiny::downloadButton(...)
  tag$attribs$download <- NULL
  tag$attribs$target <- "_blank"
  tag
}

safe_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", x)
  if (!nzchar(x)) "Sample" else x
}

metric_table <- function(dat) {
  vals <- unlist(dat[1, , drop = FALSE], use.names = TRUE)
  data.frame(Metric = names(vals), Value = as.character(vals), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

status_badge <- function(status) {
  cls <- switch(status, PASS = "qc-pass", WARNING = "qc-warning", FAIL = "qc-fail", "qc-warning")
  tags$span(class = paste("qc-badge", cls), status)
}

risk_card <- function(title, score, percentile, tertile) {

    h3(title),
    div(class = "risk-score", sprintf("%.3f", score)),
    div(class = "risk-label", "Frozen ridge-Cox log-hazard"),
    div(class = "percentile-value", sprintf("%.1f percentile", 100 * percentile)),
    div(class = "risk-label", "Relative to DOG2 training animals"),
    div(class = "tertile-label", tertile)
  )
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  result <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  error_message <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  running <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

  output$has_result <- reactive(!is.null(result()))
  outputOptions(output, "has_result", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$run_prediction, {
    result(NULL)
    error_message(NULL)
    req(input$count_file)
    sample_id <- trimws(input$sample_id)
    validate(need(nzchar(sample_id), "Enter a Sample ID."))
    running(TRUE)
    on.exit(running(FALSE), add = TRUE)

    ans <- tryCatch(
      withProgress(message = "Running in your browser", value = 0, {
        incProgress(0.2, detail = "Reading input")
        out <- predict_all56_browser(
          model_bundle = MODEL,
          mapping = MAPPING,
          counts_path = input$count_file$datapath,
          original_name = input$count_file$name,
          sample_id = sample_id,
          gene_id_type = input$gene_id_type,
          missing_gene_policy = if (isTRUE(input$omitted_rows_zero)) "zero_fill" else "fail"
        )
        incProgress(0.8, detail = "Scoring 56 signatures")
        out
      }),
      error = function(e) {
        error_message(conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (!is.null(ans)) result(ans)
  })

  output$analysis_status <- renderUI({
    if (running()) return(div(class = "status-panel", "Running prediction..."))
    err <- error_message()
    if (!is.null(err)) return(div(class = "status-panel status-error", h4("Prediction stopped"), p(err)))
    x <- result()
    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(div(class = "status-panel", "Upload a file to see results."))
    }
    q <- x$qc
    div(
      class = "status-panel",
      h4("QC status: ", status_badge(q$overall_QC[[1]])),
      p(sprintf(
        "Model-gene coverage: %.1f%% | Detected locked genes: %s/%s",
        100 * q$model_gene_coverage_fraction[[1]],
        q$n_detected_locked_genes[[1]], q$n_locked_rank_genes[[1]]
      ))
    )
  })

  output$risk_summary <- renderUI({
    x <- result(); req(x)
    p <- x$prediction
    tagList(
      div(
        class = "risk-grid",
        risk_card("Disease-free interval", p$DFI_frozen_log_hazard[[1]], p$DFI_DOG2_percentile[[1]], p$DFI_DOG2_tertile[[1]]),
        risk_card("Overall survival", p$OS_frozen_log_hazard[[1]], p$OS_DOG2_percentile[[1]], p$OS_DOG2_tertile[[1]])
      ),
      p(class = "agi-small", "Percentiles are relative to DOG2 training animals, not probabilities.")
    )
  })

  output$qc_table <- renderTable({ x <- result(); req(x); metric_table(x$qc) }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "xs")
  output$mapping_table <- renderTable({ x <- result(); req(x); metric_table(x$mapping_qc) }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "xs")

  contribution_table <- function(x, endpoint) {
    sr <- x$signature_results
    col <- paste0(endpoint, "_contribution")
    coef_col <- paste0(endpoint, "_coefficient")
    ord <- order(abs(sr[[col]]), decreasing = TRUE)
    sr <- sr[ord[seq_len(min(10, nrow(sr)))], , drop = FALSE]
    label <- if ("signature_name" %in% names(sr)) ifelse(is.na(sr$signature_name) | !nzchar(sr$signature_name), sr$signature_id, sr$signature_name) else sr$signature_id
    data.frame(
      Signature = label,
      Direction = ifelse(sr[[col]] >= 0, "Raises score", "Lowers score"),
      Standardized = round(sr$DOG2_standardized_score, 3),
      Coefficient = round(sr[[coef_col]], 4),
      Contribution = round(sr[[col]], 4),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  output$dfi_table <- renderTable({ x <- result(); req(x); contribution_table(x, "DFI") }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "xs")
  output$os_table <- renderTable({ x <- result(); req(x); contribution_table(x, "OS") }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "xs")
  output$all_table <- renderTable({
    x <- result(); req(x)
    sr <- x$signature_results
    label <- if ("signature_name" %in% names(sr)) ifelse(is.na(sr$signature_name) | !nzchar(sr$signature_name), sr$signature_id, sr$signature_name) else sr$signature_id
    source <- if ("signature_source" %in% names(sr)) sr$signature_source else ""
    data.frame(
      Signature = label,
      Source = source,
      `Raw singscore` = round(sr$raw_singscore, 4),
      `DOG2 standardized` = round(sr$DOG2_standardized_score, 3),
      `DFI contribution` = round(sr$DFI_contribution, 4),
      `OS contribution` = round(sr$OS_contribution, 4),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "xs")

  output$download_prediction <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      x <- result(); req(x)
      paste0(safe_sample_id(x$prediction$sample_id[[1]]), "_all56_prediction.tsv")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      x <- result(); req(x)
      write.table(x$prediction, file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    },
    contentType = "text/tab-separated-values; charset=utf-8"
  )



  output$download_pdf <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      x <- result(); req(x)
      paste0(safe_sample_id(x$prediction$sample_id[[1]]), "_all56_report.pdf")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      x <- result(); req(x)
      p <- x$prediction; q <- x$qc
      grDevices::pdf(file, width = 8.5, height = 11)
      on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
      plot.new()
      text(0, 0.96, "AGI | DOG2 all56 prognosis predictor", adj = c(0, 1), cex = 1.3, font = 2, col = "#006A32")
      text(0, 0.88, paste("Sample ID:", p$sample_id[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.82, paste("QC:", q$overall_QC[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1), font = 2)
      text(0, 0.72, sprintf("DFI log-hazard: %.3f", p$DFI_frozen_log_hazard[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.66, sprintf("DFI DOG2 percentile: %.1f", 100 * p$DFI_DOG2_percentile[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.58, sprintf("OS log-hazard: %.3f", p$OS_frozen_log_hazard[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.52, sprintf("OS DOG2 percentile: %.1f", 100 * p$OS_DOG2_percentile[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.38, sprintf("Model-gene coverage: %.1f%%", 100 * q$model_gene_coverage_fraction[[1]]), adj = c(0, 1))
      text(0, 0.22, "Research use only. Percentiles are not probabilities.", adj = c(0, 1), font = 2)
      text(0, 0.15, "Analysis executed locally in the browser using Shinylive/webR.", adj = c(0, 1), cex = 0.9)
    },
    contentType = "application/pdf"
  )
}

content:
# DOG2 all56 Shinylive PWA

This version wraps the server-free Shinylive app as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA).

## What it adds

- Web App Manifest with `display: standalone`
- iPhone/iPad Home Screen icon
- 192 px, 512 px, and maskable icons
- Service worker with app-shell precaching and runtime caching
- iPhone installation prompt
- Safe-area spacing for notched iPhones
- GitHub Pages `.nojekyll`
- An in-app **Install** tab

This is an installable website, not an App Store binary.

## 1. Prepare the frozen browser assets

Use the same command as the Shinylive-only version:

```bash
APP="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_all56_shinylive_pwa_ready"
MODEL_DIR="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_reanalysis/10_external_validation/10d_Cohort4_independent_canine_validation/10d2_locked_all56_projection/outputs/final"
MAPPING="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_reanalysis/02_dog_human_ortholog_mapping/outputs/DOG2_dog_to_human_ortholog_primary_one2one.tsv"

Rscript \
  "$APP/prepare_shinylive_assets.R" \
  "$MODEL_DIR" \
  "$MAPPING" \
  "$APP/assets"
```

Expected:

```text
assets/shinylive_model_bundle.rds
assets/dog_human_mapping.rds
```

## 2. Export the PWA site

```bash
SITE="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_all56_shinylive_pwa_site"

Rscript \
  "$APP/export_shinylive.R" \
  "$APP" \
  "$SITE"
```

The export script runs `shinylive::export()` and then automatically adds the PWA wrapper.

## 3. Validate the PWA files

```bash
Rscript "$APP/check_pwa_site.R" "$SITE"
```

Expected:

```text
PWA check PASSED
```

## 4. Preview locally

```bash
Rscript -e "
httpuv::runStaticServer(
  '$SITE',
  host = '127.0.0.1',
  port = 8008
)
"
```

Open:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:8008
```

Service workers are allowed on `127.0.0.1` for local development.

## 5. Update the GitHub Pages repository

Assuming the generated GitHub Pages repository is:

```bash
REPO="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_all56_shinylive_pages"
```

Copy the new PWA site while retaining `.git`:

```bash
rsync -a --delete \
  --exclude=".git/" \
  "$SITE/" \
  "$REPO/"

touch "$REPO/.nojekyll"

cd "$REPO"
git add -A
git commit -m "Add PWA wrapper"
git push
```

In GitHub repository settings, keep **Pages → Deploy from a branch → main / root**, and enable **Enforce HTTPS**.

## 6. Install on iPhone

1. Open the GitHub Pages URL in Safari.
2. Tap the **Share** icon.
3. Tap **Add to Home Screen**.
4. Tap **Add**.
5. Open **DOG2 Predictor** from the Home Screen.

It should launch in standalone mode without the normal Safari address bar.

## Caching behavior

The PWA precaches only the small app shell. Large Shinylive/webR files are cached as the browser requests them. Therefore:

- the first complete launch still needs internet access;
- leave the app open until Shinylive has fully loaded;
- later launches should be faster;
- offline operation is expected only for assets already loaded and retained in browser cache.

## Updating the PWA cache

When publishing a materially changed app, edit this line in `pwa/service-worker.js`:

```javascript
const CACHE_NAME = `${CACHE_PREFIX}2026-07-29-v1`;
```

For example, change `v1` to `v2`, then export and push again. The new service worker deletes the old DOG2 PWA cache after activation.

## Public model warning

GitHub Pages distributes the frozen model bundle and mapping to every browser. Do not publish this repository unless those assets may be publicly downloadable.

name: README_SHINYLIVE.md
content:
# DOG2 all56 Shinylive server-free build

This variant runs the prediction inside the user's browser with Shinylive/webR. It does not use a Shiny compute server.

## Important architecture change

The original Shiny app loads `singscore` and `glmnet`. The browser build instead:

1. extracts the frozen Cox coefficient vectors locally once;
2. stores the 56 gene sets, rank universe, training standardization values and DOG2 reference scores in a compact RDS bundle;
3. computes the documented rank-based singscore formula with base R in the browser;
4. applies the frozen coefficient vectors with a dot product.

This keeps the browser dependency set small and avoids Bioconductor/compiled-model runtime dependencies.

## 1. Prepare browser assets

```bash
APP="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_all56_shinylive_ready"

MODEL_DIR="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_reanalysis/10_external_validation/10d_Cohort4_independent_canine_validation/10d2_locked_all56_projection/outputs/final"

MAPPING="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_reanalysis/02_dog_human_ortholog_mapping/outputs/DOG2_dog_to_human_ortholog_primary_one2one.tsv"

Rscript "$APP/prepare_shinylive_assets.R" \
  "$MODEL_DIR" \
  "$MAPPING" \
  "$APP/assets"
```

Expected files:

```text
assets/shinylive_model_bundle.rds
assets/dog_human_mapping.rds
```

## 2. Test the lightweight app as ordinary local Shiny

```bash
Rscript -e "shiny::runApp('$APP', port=3840, launch.browser=TRUE)"
```

Use the known validation sample first.

## 3. Run numerical parity validation

```bash
ORIGINAL_BACKEND="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_reanalysis/11_prediction_shiny_app/11a_predict_all56_from_read_counts.R"
COUNT_FILE="/path/to/GSE239948_CCOGC.txt"

Rscript "$APP/validate_shinylive_parity.R" \
  "$ORIGINAL_BACKEND" \
  "$MODEL_DIR" \
  "$APP/assets/shinylive_model_bundle.rds" \
  "$APP/assets/dog_human_mapping.rds" \
  "$COUNT_FILE" \
  "CCB010057" \
  "human_symbol" \
  "NONE"
```

The script requires the four reported values to agree within `1e-10`.

## 4. Install and export Shinylive

```bash
Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("shinylive", "httpuv"), repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")'

SITE="/Users/yukaimamura/Downloads/AGI/avani/DOG2_all56_shinylive_site"

Rscript "$APP/export_shinylive.R" "$APP" "$SITE"
```

## 5. Preview correctly

Do not double-click `index.html`. Serve the directory:

```bash
Rscript -e "httpuv::runStaticServer('$SITE')"
```

Open the printed local URL. Initial loading is slower than conventional Shiny because the browser loads webR and the Shiny WebAssembly packages.

## 6. Static hosting

The exported `SITE` directory can be hosted on GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, institutional static hosting, or another ordinary HTTPS static host.

## Privacy and intellectual-property warning

- Uploaded expression data are processed in the browser rather than sent to a Shiny compute server.
- The static host still serves the application files.
- The model RDS bundle and dog-human mapping are downloaded to every browser and therefore are not secret.
- Do not publish the static site until public distribution of the frozen model coefficients, signatures and mapping is approved.
- This remains research-use-only and not clinically validated.

# Browser-safe DOG2 all56 prediction backend.
# Uses base R only; model coefficients and reference data are pre-extracted.

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("\\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "NaN", "-")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  x <- gsub('"', "", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- toupper(gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_ensembl <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  x <- gsub('"', "", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- toupper(gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

canonical_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(clean_text(x))
  x <- sub("^GSM[0-9]+[_-]*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

open_uploaded_text <- function(path, original_name) {
  if (grepl("\\.(gz|bgz)$", original_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    gzfile(path, open = "rt")
  } else {
    file(path, open = "rt")
  }
}

read_uploaded_auto <- function(path, original_name) {
  con <- open_uploaded_text(path, original_name)
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  first <- readLines(con, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  if (!length(first)) stop("Input file is empty.")
  tabs <- lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr("\\t", first)))
  commas <- lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr(",", first)))
  sep <- if (tabs >= commas) "\t" else ","
  close(con)
  on.exit(NULL, add = FALSE)
  con <- open_uploaded_text(path, original_name)
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = sep,
    quote = '"',
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

pick_sample_column <- function(dat, sample_id) {
  if (ncol(dat) < 2) stop("Count file must contain a gene-ID column and a value column.")
  candidates <- names(dat)[-1]
  exact <- which(candidates == sample_id)
  if (length(exact) == 1) return(candidates[[exact]])
  canon <- which(canonical_id(candidates) == canonical_id(sample_id))
  if (length(canon) == 1) return(candidates[[canon]])
  if (length(candidates) == 1) return(candidates[[1]])
  count_like <- candidates[tolower(candidates) %in% c(
    "count", "counts", "read_count", "read_counts", "value", "expression"
  )]
  if (length(count_like) == 1) return(count_like[[1]])
  stop(
    "Could not select one sample column for sample ID '", sample_id,
    "'. Available value columns: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

read_one_sample_counts <- function(path, original_name, sample_id, gene_id_type) {
  dat <- read_uploaded_auto(path, original_name)
  gene_col <- names(dat)[[1]]
  value_col <- pick_sample_column(dat, sample_id)
  values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[value_col]]))
  if (length(values) != nrow(dat) || anyNA(values) || any(!is.finite(values))) {
    stop("The selected value column contains missing or non-numeric values: ", value_col)
  }
  if (any(values < 0)) stop("Counts/expression values cannot be negative.")
  ids <- if (gene_id_type == "dog_ensembl") clean_ensembl(dat[[gene_col]]) else clean_symbol(dat[[gene_col]])
  keep <- !is.na(ids)
  data.frame(
    input_row = seq_len(nrow(dat))[keep],
    input_gene_id_original = as.character(dat[[gene_col]])[keep],
    input_gene_id = ids[keep],
    value = values[keep],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

make_unique_map <- function(mapping, id_col) {
  x <- mapping[, c(id_col, "human_symbol"), drop = FALSE]
  names(x)[1] <- "input_id"
  x <- x[!is.na(x$input_id) & !is.na(x$human_symbol), , drop = FALSE]
  x <- unique(x)
  counts <- table(x$input_id)
  ambiguous <- names(counts[counts > 1])
  x <- x[!x$input_id %in% ambiguous, , drop = FALSE]
  list(data = x, ambiguous = ambiguous)
}

map_to_human <- function(input_counts, gene_id_type, mapping) {
  if (gene_id_type == "human_symbol") {
    mapped <- input_counts
    mapped$human_symbol <- clean_symbol(mapped$input_gene_id)
    mapped$mapping_status <- "human symbol supplied"
    mapping_info <- list(n_rows = NA_integer_, n_unique = length(unique(mapped$input_gene_id)), n_ambiguous = 0L)
  } else {
    id_col <- if (gene_id_type == "dog_ensembl") "dog_ensembl" else "dog_symbol"
    prepared <- make_unique_map(mapping, id_col)
    idx <- match(input_counts$input_gene_id, prepared$data$input_id)
    mapped <- input_counts
    mapped$human_symbol <- prepared$data$human_symbol[idx]
    mapped$mapping_status <- ifelse(is.na(mapped$human_symbol), "unmapped", "mapped")
    mapping_info <- list(
      n_rows = nrow(mapping),
      n_unique = length(unique(prepared$data$input_id)),
      n_ambiguous = length(prepared$ambiguous)
    )
  }

  usable <- mapped[!is.na(mapped$human_symbol), c("human_symbol", "value"), drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(usable)) stop("No input genes could be mapped to human symbols.")
  sums <- tapply(usable$value, usable$human_symbol, sum)
  collapsed <- data.frame(
    human_symbol = names(sums),
    value = as.numeric(sums),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  list(mapped = mapped, collapsed = collapsed, mapping_info = mapping_info)
}

singscore_up_centered <- function(ranks, genes) {
  genes <- unique(intersect(genes, names(ranks)))
  m <- length(genes)
  n <- length(ranks)
  if (m == 0) return(NA_real_)
  low <- (m + 1) / 2
  high <- (2 * n - m + 1) / 2
  ((mean(ranks[genes]) - low) / (high - low)) - 0.5
}

empirical_percentile <- function(reference, value) {
  reference <- reference[is.finite(reference)]
  mean(reference <= value)
}

risk_tertile <- function(reference, value) {
  cutpoints <- as.numeric(quantile(reference, probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  if (value <= cutpoints[[1]]) return("DOG2-relative low")
  if (value <= cutpoints[[2]]) return("DOG2-relative intermediate")
  "DOG2-relative high"
}

qc_status <- function(model_coverage, detected_fraction, zero_fraction, integer_like) {
  if (model_coverage < 0.80) return("FAIL")
  if (model_coverage < 0.95 || detected_fraction < 0.40 || zero_fraction > 0.60 || !integer_like) return("WARNING")
  "PASS"
}

predict_all56_browser <- function(
    model_bundle,
    mapping,
    counts_path,
    original_name,
    sample_id,
    gene_id_type,
    missing_gene_policy = c("fail", "zero_fill"),
    min_model_gene_coverage = 0.95,
    min_detected_model_fraction = 0.40) {

  missing_gene_policy <- match.arg(missing_gene_policy)
  input_counts <- read_one_sample_counts(counts_path, original_name, sample_id, gene_id_type)
  mapped <- map_to_human(input_counts, gene_id_type, mapping)

  rank_genes <- model_bundle$rank_genes
  collapsed <- mapped$collapsed
  present <- intersect(rank_genes, collapsed$human_symbol)
  missing <- setdiff(rank_genes, present)
  coverage <- length(present) / length(rank_genes)

  integer_like <- all(abs(input_counts$value - round(input_counts$value)) < 1e-8)
  if (length(missing) && missing_gene_policy == "fail") {
    stop(
      "Prediction stopped: ", length(missing),
      " locked rank genes are absent. Enable zero-fill only when omitted rows truly mean zero."
    )
  }

  values <- setNames(rep(0, length(rank_genes)), rank_genes)
  values[present] <- collapsed$value[match(present, collapsed$human_symbol)]
  detected <- sum(values > 0)
  detected_fraction <- detected / length(values)
  zero_fraction <- mean(values == 0)
  status <- qc_status(coverage, detected_fraction, zero_fraction, integer_like)
  if (coverage < min_model_gene_coverage) status <- if (coverage < 0.80) "FAIL" else "WARNING"
  if (detected_fraction < min_detected_model_fraction) status <- if (detected_fraction < 0.20) "FAIL" else "WARNING"
  if (status == "FAIL") stop("Prediction stopped because input QC status is FAIL.")

  ranks <- rank(values, ties.method = "min")
  names(ranks) <- names(values)
  ids <- model_bundle$signature_ids
  raw_scores <- vapply(ids, function(id) singscore_up_centered(ranks, model_bundle$gene_sets[[id]]), numeric(1))
  if (any(!is.finite(raw_scores))) stop("One or more signatures could not be scored.")
  standardized <- (raw_scores - model_bundle$training_mean[ids]) / model_bundle$training_sd[ids]
  dfi_risk <- sum(standardized * model_bundle$dfi_beta[ids])
  os_risk <- sum(standardized * model_bundle$os_beta[ids])
  dfi_pct <- empirical_percentile(model_bundle$dfi_reference, dfi_risk)
  os_pct <- empirical_percentile(model_bundle$os_reference, os_risk)

  dictionary <- model_bundle$signature_dictionary
  dictionary <- dictionary[match(ids, dictionary$signature_id), , drop = FALSE]
  signature_results <- data.frame(
    signature_id = ids,
    raw_singscore = as.numeric(raw_scores[ids]),
    DOG2_standardized_score = as.numeric(standardized[ids]),
    DFI_coefficient = as.numeric(model_bundle$dfi_beta[ids]),
    DFI_contribution = as.numeric(standardized[ids] * model_bundle$dfi_beta[ids]),
    OS_coefficient = as.numeric(model_bundle$os_beta[ids]),
    OS_contribution = as.numeric(standardized[ids] * model_bundle$os_beta[ids]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  extra_cols <- setdiff(names(dictionary), "signature_id")
  if (length(extra_cols)) signature_results <- cbind(signature_results, dictionary[, extra_cols, drop = FALSE])

  signature_coverage <- data.frame(
    signature_id = ids,
    signature_genes = vapply(ids, function(id) length(unique(model_bundle$gene_sets[[id]])), integer(1)),
    genes_present_in_input = vapply(ids, function(id) sum(unique(model_bundle$gene_sets[[id]]) %in% present), integer(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  signature_coverage$input_coverage_percent <- 100 * signature_coverage$genes_present_in_input / signature_coverage$signature_genes

  qc <- data.frame(
    sample_id = sample_id,
    gene_id_type = gene_id_type,
    overall_QC = status,
    input_rows = nrow(input_counts),
    unique_input_gene_IDs = length(unique(input_counts$input_gene_id)),
    duplicate_input_rows = nrow(input_counts) - length(unique(input_counts$input_gene_id)),
    input_library_sum = sum(input_counts$value),
    integer_like_values = integer_like,
    mapped_input_rows = sum(!is.na(mapped$mapped$human_symbol)),
    unique_mapped_human_symbols = nrow(collapsed),
    n_locked_rank_genes = length(rank_genes),
    n_present_locked_rank_genes = length(present),
    n_missing_locked_rank_genes = length(missing),
    model_gene_coverage_fraction = coverage,
    n_detected_locked_genes = detected,
    detected_locked_gene_fraction = detected_fraction,
    zero_fraction_locked_genes = zero_fraction,
    missing_gene_policy = missing_gene_policy,
    n_signatures = length(ids),
    n_signatures_with_100pct_input_coverage = sum(signature_coverage$input_coverage_percent == 100),
    median_signature_input_coverage_percent = median(signature_coverage$input_coverage_percent),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  mapping_qc <- data.frame(
    gene_id_type = gene_id_type,
    bundled_mapping_rows = mapped$mapping_info$n_rows,
    unique_usable_mapping_IDs = mapped$mapping_info$n_unique,
    ambiguous_mapping_IDs_excluded = mapped$mapping_info$n_ambiguous,
    input_rows = nrow(input_counts),
    mapped_rows = sum(!is.na(mapped$mapped$human_symbol)),
    unmapped_rows = sum(is.na(mapped$mapped$human_symbol)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  prediction <- data.frame(
    sample_id = sample_id,
    model_version = model_bundle$model_version,
    runtime = "Shinylive / browser-local webR",
    gene_id_type = gene_id_type,
    overall_QC = status,
    DFI_frozen_log_hazard = dfi_risk,
    DFI_DOG2_percentile = dfi_pct,
    DFI_DOG2_tertile = risk_tertile(model_bundle$dfi_reference, dfi_risk),
    OS_frozen_log_hazard = os_risk,
    OS_DOG2_percentile = os_pct,
    OS_DOG2_tertile = risk_tertile(model_bundle$os_reference, os_risk),
    calibrated_probability_available = FALSE,
    external_clinical_validation = FALSE,
    research_use_only = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    qc = qc,
    mapping_qc = mapping_qc,
    prediction = prediction,
    signature_results = signature_results,
    signature_coverage = signature_coverage,
    mapped_rows = mapped$mapped
  )
}

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# Prepare compact browser-safe assets for the DOG2 all56 Shinylive app.
# This script runs locally once. The exported app does not require glmnet
# or singscore in the browser.

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) < 3) {
  stop(
    "Usage: Rscript prepare_shinylive_assets.R ",
    "<locked_model_dir> <primary_one2one_mapping.tsv[.gz]> <app_assets_dir>"
  )
}

model_dir <- normalizePath(args[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
mapping_file <- normalizePath(args[[2]], mustWork = TRUE)
asset_dir <- args[[3]]
dir.create(asset_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
asset_dir <- normalizePath(asset_dir, mustWork = TRUE)

if (!requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install glmnet first: install.packages('glmnet')")
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("\\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "NaN", "-")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  x <- gsub('"', "", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- toupper(gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_ensembl <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  x <- gsub('"', "", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- toupper(gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

open_text <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("\\.(gz|bgz)$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    gzfile(path, open = "rt")
  } else {
    file(path, open = "rt")
  }
}

read_auto <- function(path) {
  con <- open_text(path)
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  first <- readLines(con, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  if (!length(first)) stop("Empty file: ", path)
  sep <- if (lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr("\\t", first))) >=
             lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr(",", first)))) "\t" else ","
  close(con)
  on.exit(NULL, add = FALSE)
  con <- open_text(path)
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = sep,
    quote = '"',
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

pick_column <- function(dat, exact, patterns, label) {
  nms <- names(dat)
  lower <- tolower(nms)
  for (candidate in exact) {
    hit <- which(lower == tolower(candidate))
    if (length(hit) == 1) return(nms[[hit]])
  }
  for (pattern in patterns) {
    hit <- grep(pattern, lower)
    if (length(hit) == 1) return(nms[[hit]])
  }
  stop("Could not identify ", label, " column. Available: ", paste(nms, collapse = ", "))
}

model_file <- file.path(model_dir, "01_locked_GSE239948_compatible_all56_models.rds")
reference_file <- file.path(model_dir, "05_DOG2_training_animal_scores_and_risk.tsv.gz")
if (!file.exists(model_file)) stop("Missing model: ", model_file)
if (!file.exists(reference_file)) stop("Missing reference: ", reference_file)

locked <- readRDS(model_file)
required <- c(
  "signature_ids", "signature_dictionary", "gene_sets", "common_rank_genes",
  "training_score_mean", "training_score_sd", "DFI_model", "DFI_lambda",
  "OS_model", "OS_lambda"
)
missing <- setdiff(required, names(locked))
if (length(missing)) stop("Locked model is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

signature_ids <- as.character(locked$signature_ids)
rank_genes <- unique(na.omit(clean_symbol(locked$common_rank_genes)))

gene_sets <- lapply(signature_ids, function(id) {
  unique(na.omit(clean_symbol(locked$gene_sets[[id]])))
})
names(gene_sets) <- signature_ids

training_mean <- as.numeric(locked$training_score_mean[signature_ids])
names(training_mean) <- signature_ids
training_sd <- as.numeric(locked$training_score_sd[signature_ids])
names(training_sd) <- signature_ids
if (any(!is.finite(training_mean)) || any(!is.finite(training_sd)) || any(training_sd <= 0)) {
  stop("Invalid training mean/SD values in locked model.")
}

# Loading the namespace registers coef.glmnet methods.
loadNamespace("glmnet")
dfi_beta <- as.matrix(stats::coef(locked$DFI_model, s = locked$DFI_lambda))[, 1]
os_beta <- as.matrix(stats::coef(locked$OS_model, s = locked$OS_lambda))[, 1]
dfi_beta <- as.numeric(dfi_beta[signature_ids]); names(dfi_beta) <- signature_ids
os_beta <- as.numeric(os_beta[signature_ids]); names(os_beta) <- signature_ids
if (any(!is.finite(dfi_beta)) || any(!is.finite(os_beta))) {
  stop("Could not extract complete frozen coefficient vectors.")
}

reference <- read_auto(reference_file)
for (nm in c("DFI_frozen_log_hazard", "OS_frozen_log_hazard")) {
  if (!nm %in% names(reference)) stop("Reference file is missing column: ", nm)
}

sig_dict <- as.data.frame(locked$signature_dictionary, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"signature_id" %in% names(sig_dict)) {
  stop("signature_dictionary has no signature_id column")
}
sig_dict$signature_id <- as.character(sig_dict$signature_id)
sig_dict <- sig_dict[match(signature_ids, sig_dict$signature_id), , drop = FALSE]

model_bundle <- list(
  bundle_format = "DOG2_all56_shinylive_v1",
  created_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
  source_model_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(model_file)),
  source_reference_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(reference_file)),
  model_version = "Stage10D2 GSE239948-compatible all56 ridge Cox",
  signature_ids = signature_ids,
  signature_dictionary = sig_dict,
  gene_sets = gene_sets,
  rank_genes = rank_genes,
  training_mean = training_mean,
  training_sd = training_sd,
  dfi_beta = dfi_beta,
  os_beta = os_beta,
  dfi_reference = as.numeric(reference$DFI_frozen_log_hazard),
  os_reference = as.numeric(reference$OS_frozen_log_hazard),
  dfi_lambda = as.numeric(locked$DFI_lambda),
  os_lambda = as.numeric(locked$OS_lambda)
)

mapping_raw <- read_auto(mapping_file)
dog_ensembl_col <- pick_column(
  mapping_raw,
  c("dog_ensembl_gene_id", "dog_ensembl", "dog_gene_id", "gene_id"),
  c("dog.*ensembl", "canine.*ensembl", "dog.*gene.*id"),
  "dog Ensembl ID"
)
dog_symbol_col <- pick_column(
  mapping_raw,
  c("dog_symbol", "dog_gene_symbol", "canine_symbol", "canine_gene_symbol"),
  c("dog.*symbol", "canine.*symbol"),
  "dog symbol"
)
human_symbol_col <- pick_column(
  mapping_raw,
  c("human_symbol", "human_gene_symbol", "hgnc_symbol", "primary_human_symbol"),
  c("human.*symbol", "hgnc.*symbol", "primary.*human"),
  "human symbol"
)

mapping <- data.frame(
  dog_ensembl = clean_ensembl(mapping_raw[[dog_ensembl_col]]),
  dog_symbol = clean_symbol(mapping_raw[[dog_symbol_col]]),
  human_symbol = clean_symbol(mapping_raw[[human_symbol_col]]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
mapping <- mapping[!is.na(mapping$human_symbol), , drop = FALSE]
mapping <- unique(mapping)

model_out <- file.path(asset_dir, "shinylive_model_bundle.rds")
mapping_out <- file.path(asset_dir, "dog_human_mapping.rds")
saveRDS(model_bundle, model_out, compress = "gzip")
saveRDS(mapping, mapping_out, compress = "gzip")

cat("Prepared Shinylive assets:\n")
cat("- ", model_out, "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", mapping_out, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Signatures: ", length(signature_ids), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Rank-universe genes: ", length(rank_genes), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Mapping rows: ", nrow(mapping), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Model asset size: ", format(file.info(model_out)$size, big.mark = ","), " bytes\n", sep = "")
cat("Mapping asset size: ", format(file.info(mapping_out)$size, big.mark = ","), " bytes\n", sep = "")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) < 8) {
  stop(
    "Usage: Rscript validate_shinylive_parity.R ",
    "<original_backend.R> <model_dir> <model_bundle.rds> <mapping.rds> ",
    "<count_file> <sample_id> <gene_id_type> <mapping_tsv_or_NONE>"
  )
}
script_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value = TRUE)
script_dir <- if (length(script_arg)) dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", script_arg[[1]]))) else getwd()

original_backend <- normalizePath(args[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
model_dir <- normalizePath(args[[2]], mustWork = TRUE)
model_bundle_file <- normalizePath(args[[3]], mustWork = TRUE)
mapping_rds <- normalizePath(args[[4]], mustWork = TRUE)
count_file <- normalizePath(args[[5]], mustWork = TRUE)
sample_id <- args[[6]]
gene_id_type <- args[[7]]
mapping_tsv <- args[[8]]
if (toupper(mapping_tsv) == "NONE") mapping_tsv <- NULL else mapping_tsv <- normalizePath(mapping_tsv, mustWork = TRUE)

orig_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source(original_backend, envir = orig_env)
browser_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source(file.path(script_dir, "backend_shinylive.R"), envir = browser_env)

old_out <- tempfile("dog2_original_")
dir.create(old_out)
on.exit(unlink(old_out, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)

original <- orig_env$predict_all56_from_counts(
  model_dir = model_dir,
  counts_file = count_file,
  sample_id = sample_id,
  gene_id_type = gene_id_type,
  mapping_file = mapping_tsv,
  output_dir = old_out,
  missing_gene_policy = "zero_fill"
)

browser <- browser_env$predict_all56_browser(
  model_bundle = readRDS(model_bundle_file),
  mapping = readRDS(mapping_rds),
  counts_path = count_file,
  original_name = basename(count_file),
  sample_id = sample_id,
  gene_id_type = gene_id_type,
  missing_gene_policy = "zero_fill"
)

fields <- c(
  "DFI_frozen_log_hazard", "DFI_DOG2_percentile",
  "OS_frozen_log_hazard", "OS_DOG2_percentile"
)
comparison <- data.frame(
  field = fields,
  original = vapply(fields, function(f) as.numeric(original$prediction[[f]][[1]]), numeric(1)),
  shinylive = vapply(fields, function(f) as.numeric(browser$prediction[[f]][[1]]), numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
comparison$absolute_difference <- abs(comparison$original - comparison$shinylive)
print(comparison, row.names = FALSE)
max_diff <- max(comparison$absolute_difference)
cat("Maximum absolute difference:", format(max_diff, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
if (!is.finite(max_diff) || max_diff > 1e-10) {
  stop("Parity check FAILED: difference exceeds 1e-10")
}
cat("Parity check PASSED.\n")
